edition.notes: Volume I of Swete's edition, covering Genesis through 4 Kings. Its base text is Codex Vaticanus; the foot apparatus cites Alexandrinus, the Cotton Genesis, and other identified witnesses by siglum. Swete died in 1917 and the edition is in the public domain. Keep it distinct from Rahlfs' Septuaginta and from the Gottingen Septuaginta, whose Genesis was edited by Wevers; neither of those was consulted for any record registered here.

work.author: Henry Barclay Swete, editor
work.description: Swete's three-volume Cambridge manual edition of the Greek Old Testament, printing Codex Vaticanus where it survives with a foot apparatus of readings from Alexandrinus, Sinaiticus, and other identified uncials. Volume I covers Genesis through 4 Kings. It is a diplomatic manual edition, not a fully reconstructed critical text; consumers must not treat its readings as the judgment of the Gottingen Septuaginta. A locus is BookToken.chapter.verse in the Greek versification, which differs from the Hebrew in several books.
work.title: The Old Testament in Greek according to the Septuagint
